preconditions.description: The input tiles must be a string.
The length of tiles must be between 1 and 7 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in tiles)
preconditions.description: All characters in tiles must be uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for seq in _generate_all_sequences(tiles) if seq != '')
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of all distinct non-empty sequences that can be formed using the letters in tiles, where each letter from tiles is used at most as many times as it appears in tiles.

semantic_helpers._generate_all_sequences: A helper function that yields every distinct non-empty sequence formable from the multiset of characters in tiles, respecting character counts.
